cases.proves_bugs: BUG-236 (the PD1 text is linked to its drain: MOVE of the drain moves the text by the same 1000 mm, ERASE of the drain erases the text; COPY and renumber are not driven)
cases.title: The PD1 text of a perimeter drain moves with the drain on MOVE and goes with it on ERASE
cases.plan_item: Perimeter drain tag (triage group R2; daily card D07 neighbour); BUG-236
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Compared by the builder on 25 Oct 2026 with BUG-236 in BUG_CARPARK.md (test that catches it: erase / move / copy a perimeter drain: its PD1 text follows or goes; the height reads from Settings). COPY (a second PD1) and the height from Settings are NOT driven here.
cases.expected: After CDPERIMETER places PD1 (polyline and text PD1 on layer AGI DRAIN), a native MOVE of the drain polyline by 0,1000 moves the PD1 text by 1000 as well (its y is 1000 higher), and ERASE of the drain polyline leaves no PD1 text in the drawing. The drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: The link between the drawn tag and its drain is kept by CE watching native MOVE and ERASE in the live drawing.
not_automated: COPY of a drain (a second PD1), renumbering and the text height read from Settings (the other halves of BUG-236) are not driven.
